purpose: First deterministic blocker-removal pilot targeting recovery followed by success
timing_basis: Prior partial-blocker pilots entered their first Wait recovery about 5.8 to 8.0 s after accepted goal; the accepted goal occurs near simulation time 4 s. Removal at fixed simulation time 12 s targets that first recovery boundary without observing e011.
inclusion_rule: Include only if simulator/capture quality gates pass, terminal status is succeeded, recovery history is complete, at least one unique recovery attempt is recorded, and evaluator truth confirms actual blocker removal.
mismatch_rule: Retain any artifact but classify as development calibration and do not relabel it into the intended family.
evidence_boundary: Blocker geometry and detailed removal timing are evaluator-only. Robot-visible LiDAR may reflect changed geometry, but delivery does not prove Nav2 consumed it and the explanation may only claim the recorded BT mechanism unless an intervention-level analysis is explicitly performed.
